module.description: In this lesson, students will explore the expansion and factorisation of quadratic By the end of this lesson, students will be able to: Accurately expand quadratic expressions using the identities , , and Accurately factorise quadratic expressions using the identities , and . Utilise AI-generated feedback to identify and understand their errors in expansion and factorisation, with the use of identities. Identify the specific types of errors they have made, so you can learn from them. Distinguish clearly between the difference of squares identity and the perfect square trinomial identity , particularly in factorisation, by analysing common mistakes.
